@Baltachi_com I'd say the two biggest beneficiaries of the OpenClaw trade is actually Minimax (HKG: 0100) and $RPI, which are both up ~60% together.  

The rest like $AAPL are a bit too big (and probably $TWLO ) to make a material impact.…

$ALPD took on really bad debt with junk bonds at 9.25% and is connected with $CRWV, which also has a lot of bad debt really cutting into margins/FCF + OpenAI (which also doesn't have the funds yet) taking up a lot of backlog + capacity…
